QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Mistrustful King
QuestInfo.0: You investigate the Lion King's Castle with J from the Resistance. Talk to the Lion King's queen #bIfia#k in #b#m211061001##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2161001# wants you to go to the #bAudience Room#k to meet the #bLion King#k, since he doesn't seem to hear her. She'd like you to deliver her message to him. How will the Lion King react to the news of his wife? Use #p2161001# to get to the Lion King.

#r#eIf you fail the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: The Lion King is furious and tells you not to lie, as Queen #p2161001# died a long time ago. Since he hasn't forgotten about #p2161001#, he really must not hear her voice.

1.0: Have you gone to see him? Did you tell him about me? Has he...forgotten? If not, tell me why he doesn't answer.
